6.2.2.2.3 Flash Eeprom emulation
Detection
Reported by the Flash Driver (see Flash driver above).
Reaction
[SWS_Fee_00054] Implementation specific error handling.
Report
Depending on the configuration:
 [SWS_Fee_00091] [SWS_Fee_00035] The error shall be polled by
the
Memory
Abstraction
Interface
with
the
function
Fee_GetJobResult (job result set to MEMIF_JOB_FAILED).
 [SWS_Fee_00056] [SWS_Fee_00054] The error shall be reported
to
the
NVRAM
Manager
via
the
Callback
function
NvM_JobErrorNotification.
Recovery
See NVRAM Manager.
